tasks.spec: You are a trivial placeholder worker for a billed replay that Ringer's check performs itself. Boundary: do NOT run any replay, do NOT call any model or network service, do NOT touch any file except the one you own, never git commit. Your only job: write the single line 'ready run-S4' into the file /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/lead-up-contradictions/run-S4-ready.txt (create it; the directory exists).
